description: This file defines the PacketMetadata structure and related functions for handling server and license metadata in Mattermost packets, including validation, parsing, and generation.

classes.name: PacketMetadata
classes.description: Struct containing metadata about server, license, and customer info for Mattermost packets.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates the PacketMetadata fields for correctness and consistency.

methods.name: ParsePacketMetadata
methods.description: Parses YAML bytes into PacketMetadata object, validating version and content.

methods.name: GeneratePacketMetadata
methods.description: Creates a new PacketMetadata object with current timestamp, version, and optional license info.
